# Experiences

1. Undergraduate Student Researcher, Parker Lab, CWRU Department of Chemistry, 2025 - Present

    Simulating stereoisomeric conformations of organic molecules using Conformer Ensemble Screening and Optimization (CENSO) in a high performance computing environment.
    
2. Patient Companion, Cleveland Clinic, 2026

    Provide direct patient care to high-risk patients, monitoring clinical status and supporting nursing staff within an internal medicine and nutritional insufficiency unit.
    
3. Clinical Research Intern, Mayo Clinic Department of Laboratory Medicine and Pathology, 2025

    Developed ML models to estimate low-density lipoprotein levels and glomerular filtration rates, and participate in clinical shadowing and seminars as part of the Clinical Research Internship Study Program.
    
4. Undergraduate Peer Tutor, Case Western Reserve University, 2025 - Present

    Conduct targeted review sessions, grade assessments, and provide individualized test-taking strategies for students across introductory biology, physiology, and medical anthropology courses.

5. Founder of Student Advisory Board, Case Western Reserve University Office of Disability Resources, 2025 - Present

    Establish and lead a multidisciplinary student board to advise university administration on campus-wide advocacy, accessibility programming, and inclusive institutional policies.
